walkthroughs.title: Welcome to the Agent Developer Kit!
walkthroughs.description: GitHub Copilot walks you through setting up your Employee Self-Service agent and more — all in plain English. Read on to get started.

steps.title: What ADK does
steps.description:
The Agent Developer Kit lets you build, update, and publish your Employee Self-Service agent in plain English — Copilot turns your intent into set-up steps, topics, and configuration, so you don't have to write code.
If you don't already have Copilot Chat open, click the button below.
[Open Copilot Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Getting started
steps.description:
Not sure where to begin? Just tell Copilot Chat what you want. For example, to set up ESS, ask **"Help me set up ESS"**. To configure the landing page, ask **"Help me customize the landing page"**. And to check readiness before you deploy, ask **"Help me run a flightcheck"**.
Make sure setup is completed before customizing your ESS agent.

essMaker.mode.description: Install mode set by the ESS installer. 'maker' (was 'lite') applies the guided rail layout; 'developer' (was 'standard') uses the default VS Code layout with a rendered README preview. In both modes /setup is user-driven — the extension never auto-runs it. Empty string means the installer left the choice unresolved and the extension silently defaults to maker on first activation. The legacy 'lite'/'standard' values are still accepted and normalized to 'maker'/'developer' so existing users keep their choice after the rename.

essMaker.autoUpdateCheck.description: On VS Code startup, check whether the local ESS ADK clone is behind origin/main and, if so, offer a one-click update. Set to false (e.g. via IT/Intune policy) to disable the nudge on managed machines.
